## B0-A independent review — P0.2 + P0.3

**Verdict: GREEN**

Reviewer: Claude Code read-only reviewer (`vaulter-reviewer`), fresh context, model `claude-sonnet-5-5`; executor
`claude-opus-5-5/high` (D09 п.3 — независимость по модели и контексту, не по провайдеру). Date 2026-10-02.
Scope: commits `b65dc0c` (P0.2), `76aa5a0` (P0.3), `9fe91c4` (D09). No Blocker / Major.

Reviewer checks: PG Concurrency suite 4 passed / 15 assertions, exit 0; SQLite 4 skipped, exit 0; ForkRace algorithm
matches the P0.2 spec point by point; negative control requires overlap; CI step text and `if: always()` exact;
dumps hash to `SHA256SUMS`; every Scope §4 shape and the preflight-red shapes present in the SQL text; seeder uses
only the v0.2.0 autoloader; raw SQL limited and marked; determinism without post-processing; D09 consistent.

| ID | Sev | Finding | Resolution |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| R1 | Minor | `--verify` did not hash the committed `.sql` files | fixed: `sha256sum --quiet -c SHA256SUMS` on the committed dumps first |
| R2 | Minor | a `FIXTURE_CONFIGS` subset rewrote `SHA256SUMS` with only its lines | fixed: regeneration always rewrites sums over every committed dump in canonical order |
| R3 | Minor | any unknown argument fell through to regeneration | fixed: only `''`/`--verify`, else usage + exit 2 (checked: `--verfy` → exit 2) |
| R4 | Minor | worktree trusted without checking HEAD/cleanliness; floating deps (tag has no lock) | fixed: HEAD must equal `v0.2.0^{commit}` and tracked tree clean; resolved stack recorded in README |
| R5 | Minor | `--verify` byte-exact only on pg_dump 16.15; `\restrict` needs psql ≥ 16.10 | fixed (documented): README states the 16.15 tie, local check not a CI gate, psql ≥ 16.10 |
| R6 | Minor | invalid UTF-8 in a child result relabelled the failure as `UnserializableValue` | fixed: `JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE` keeps the exception class |
| R7 | Nit | CI step would pass with 4 skipped if `pcntl/posix` vanished | accepted: the job lists the extensions explicitly; `--fail-on-skipped` would change the spec'd exact step and `skipUnlessSupported` contract. Revisit if the lane is restructured |
| R8 | Nit | a task calling `exit()` | fixed (documented): ForkRace docblock + CONTRIBUTING «return or throw, never exit()» |
| R9 | Nit | missing upgrade branches: `global` blob, share revoked+deleted, soft-deleted grant twin | fixed: added to the seeder; README composition and counts updated |
| R10 | Nit | P0.3 Scope text still said `<driver>`/`DROP DATABASE` | fixed: Scope item 1 aligned with the scripts |
